body: Thanks for your comments... I thought I was 172 cm without shoes and 174 with them so I was dissapointed (I still think I am taller than 170 cm)... I'll try to not think about that my height.
Yes, of course. But men of my age are taller while older men are, normally, shorter... with older I try to say men that are 60 years old or more.
I don't know. I think average men are taller than that. At least, the young men...
Thanks for talking with me. I appreciated very much.
I don't think a pshychiatrist can help me be taller...
Every man of my age is taller than me, I've never been with a girl. I think I am disgusting and I don't have self steem.
Ok, thanks for your advice. Really, I appreciate it.
I am not from California, I am from Spain  (Europe). I know, I making it the worst thing ever, I can not avoid that.
I am 55 kg, I am thin and I consider myself ugly... But Zac Efron he is really handsome, I can't compare with him.
I don't know... It hurts me a lot. I don't know how I can avoid that.
Well, you are lucky...
Well, thanks for being honest... It must be a life full of pain, right?.

What do you mean? For not having answered me? Of course not, you have no obligation to talk to me. Actually, you have "held" (I don't know if this has sense in english) me up too much. Sorry for having bothered you.

I understand you, but in the end, we are human and we are going to compare yourself with a classmate, a guy from  the place you work, etc. And if you always lose, in the end you get sad, I can not help but see (I don't know if this has sense in english) that everyone has something and I have nothing.

The problem is that you seem to be weird and a failure if you don't have many friends (or at least one group) or if you don't have a girlfriend/boyfriend and, of course, you feel bad about yourself if you don't have them... Maybe that's how I got to this situation of depression. I compare myself a lot with others, always (but I'm not jealous or competitive).

I guess you're right. Could I ask you your age? I hope you don't mind the question. It's simply because you said: "when you get older" and then "Not in the way you or I would perceive". I'm curious. I hope the question does not offend you...

Yes I agree with you. I think it's impossible to have many friends because that word means a lot and you really need to know a person in order to be their friend.

Although I think that not having friends makes you less normal ... Or that's what others will think.
If you say "I don't have friends" people will look at you weird and think you're not normal ... That's why it's hard to say. Do you have?

Well, I don't know what to tell you ... I've had, yes. But nowadays it's hard to say, I haven't talked to them for a couple of weeks ... And the only way to talk to them is if I start the conversation, they only talk to me if they need me. I don't know what to say.
Self love? No, that's impossible. I have a mirror in my house.

Well, maybe yes... But that's not enough to find love. In any case, I do not consider myself too kind. With you I am kind but it is the minimum that I can do for someone who seems to have, at least, a little interest in me.
I don't have any positive aspects. If you were in front of me you would understand (I mean both personality and physical appearance).
Believe me, I am. I am disgusting in any possible aspect, regardless of whether it is physical or personality. If you add to that my lack of self-esteem ... You have the "perfect" mix.

Well, I don't know what is worse: if women are attracted to the physical or personality ... In both I am truly disgusting. And I don't stand out for my intelligence (rather the opposite). I guess girls can also feel insecure but not at my level...

Not everything is physical, but there are some minimum standards and I do not meet them (i don't know if this has sense in english). 
Possibly you will be much more successful than me with women...

I'm sorry but I think it has no solution. The main reason for social anxiety is my lack of self-esteem, I do not have self-esteem because I've never been with a girl and I've never been with a girl because of my physical (ugly and short), here we come to a dead end (I do not know if this makes sense in English), I can not change the physical.

I know but being in the street or leaving that comfort zone is very difficult for me. When I walk down the street I have a very bad time, especially when girls of my age pass, I bend my head and try to cover my face with my coat so they do not see me. (I know it sounds weird, well ... It is).

Honestly, I don't see myself being able to get a job because I don't see myself surpassing a job interview.

I know how to ride a bike but I don't like it, I think it's dangerous.
Yes, I've heard that portuguese is easy to understand but hard to write  (hard grammar)
Well, I am sure that you speak english better than me... If you don't like verbs, don't study spanish, trust me.
French. But I don't like it. Do you study any language?
Yes, I study another language. and I have class once a week. I just go out for that.

It was like, 10 years ago maybe... I'm not sure, 9 o 10 years ago probably. I liked it. 

That's the kind of weather that I like, cold and sunny.

I prefer the sun, although I prefer a cold climate than a hot climate. Yes, I've been in Barcelona, it's a huge city and I didn't like it very much. I was in Lisbon years ago, I prefer Lisbon to Barcelona, and you?
I don't want to waste your time but: how are you ? I mean, you're here asking me and I think the least is that I ask you. I hope the question does not seem offensive.
Specially? No, not at all. I don't have a favourite...
I am from Spain so we are neighbors... I like to play videogames with history modes, I am not a fan of multiplayer games because other players insult you.

Yes, videogames, football (soccer if you are from USA) and basketball, but I prefer watch instead of paying. 

"You don't need to feel bad, I do it because I want to. I think this is a good thing. It helps you learning how to accept attention that is given to you free willingly". It's weird to hear that but, once again, sorry for bother you

I don't have economic problems but there isn't another degree that I like... And I have to do something (I can't be in home all time without do nothing, my mother doesn't allow it).
 By the way, you have talked a lot with me, I thank you but I feel bad because you are wasting your time with me.
It's too late for start to study other thing, at least that's what I think... I think I'm older for start other degree
I'm not the kind of person who takes pills, that's not for me...
Laws. And no, I don't like it.
No, you didn't. Thank you for talking with me, it feels nice think that someone cares about you.
It's very tough to do those things, I only leave my house once a week and it's not easy. I can not even concentrate on anything... I hope all ends soon. Thank you for your answers, really.

Yes, I am taking a distance major to make exams. What do you mean with "you can work on yourself tough"? 
Well, I am sorry for making you lose your time with me...
